versions.content: If an indicator is configured (via DemIndicatorAttribute ) the Dem module shall set when the Event is reported/qualified to PASSED the UDS status bit 7 (WarningIndicatorRequested)to 0, if the following conditions are fulfilled: • all DemIndicatorHealingCycleCounterThreshold are equal to 0 • WIRbit is not enabled by calling the API Dem_SetWIRStatus
